critical_code_review_comments: Real-providers contract is correctly enforced: registry override of simulation entries works (register_provider called last in real_providers.py). Verified by 9/9 phase1 pytests — every channel (facebook/instagram/google_business/mailchimp/email/sms) returns status='failed' with actionable 'No connection configured' or 'Open AI Ads → Providers and connect ... before publishing' error when no credential row exists. Real Facebook Graph API contact verified via 'Invalid OAuth access token' error returned for invalid token — proves real httpx HTTP call (not stub).

Restaurant Automation Center is well-architected: 4 production-ready lanes (specials/reviews/loyalty/catering) each with template select, optional menu-item picker (specials lane), channel chip multi-select, and generate→schedule→library pipeline. Default sub-tab choice puts restaurant marketing front-and-center — strong UX call.
20 restaurant templates is a healthy catalog. Review/loyalty/catering coverage maps to the 4 lanes 1-to-1. Good naming convention (review_request_*, loyalty_*, catering_*).

ErrorBoundary mounted at the index.js root (above App) is the correct topology — catches errors anywhere in the tree. Fallback uses data-testid='error-boundary-fallback' for testability. Doesn't intercept normal renders (verified).
Logo bandwidth reduction 2.5MB → 101KB (~96%) via .webp is a meaningful production win. Referenced consistently 3x (nav/hero/footer).

Google Maps iframe migrated from old embed format to maps.google.com/maps?q=...&output=embed — properly renders on desktop. Tappable address (a[href=maps.google.com/?q=...]) is a nice mobile-deeplink touch.
